scope: Independent actual-app mock-DOM/network/image regressions; no browser/server/GPU
cases: four original whitespace path counterexamples rejected
retry of failed deep-link selection does not push history
retry of failed Back navigation does not push or truncate Forward
retry of failed user selection still pushes its successful selection
history push exception preserves atomic image/values/selection and gives accurate notice
repeated current selection is an idempotent no-op
stale image decode completion cannot replace newest committed data
stale failed image cannot surface retry/error after newer success
late initial-image success retains failed newest intent and matching fallback data
newer popstate invalidates pending user-click load and prevents its history push
